formula.name: Green Patchouli Cologne Balanced — Citrus Patchouli Chypre
formula.body:
### STEP 1 — BASE (add first, swirl after every 3)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL | Why |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|-----|
| 1 | Galaxolide | 50% in DEP | 700 | 0.700 | Projection musk |
| 2 | Patchouli EO | neat | 400 | 0.400 | **Star material** — high-price EO (VP 0.001 Pa, skin-substantive, not airborne) |
| 3 | Clearwood | neat | 350 | 0.350 | Clean patchouli companion |
| 4 | Benzyl Salicylate | neat | 300 | 0.300 | Fixative cushion |
| 5 | Ambrox Super | 30% w/v | 300 | 0.300 | Mineral shimmer |
| 6 | Vetiver EO | neat | 280 | 0.280 | Earthy anchor |
| 7 | Romandolide | neat | 250 | 0.250 | Clean projection musk |
| 8 | Cedramber | neat | 250 | 0.250 | Cedar-amber warmth |
| 9 | Coumarin | 20% in EtOH | 150 | 0.150 | Tonka sweetness (hedonic 0.75) |
| 10 | Evernyl | neat | 25 | 0.025 | Chypre spine — oakmoss |

**Base subtotal: 3,005 µL — swirl until homogeneous.**

---

### STEP 2 — HEART (add second, swirl after each)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL | Why |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|-----|
| 11 | Hedione | neat | 500 | 0.500 | Jasmonate radiance |
| 12 | Iso E Super | neat | 250 | 0.250 | **CUT from 500 µL** — was 70% of airborne signal, drowning everything |
| 13 | Lavender EO | neat | 150 | 0.150 | **Bumped** — VP 3.5 Pa, efficient headspace carrier (hedonic 0.75) |
| 14 | Geraniol | neat | 200 | 0.200 | **Bumped** — rosy-green bridge, friendly, hedonic 0.70 |
| 15 | Vanillin | 10% in DPG | 300 | 0.300 | **NEW** — hedonic 0.90 (highest), warmth, pairs with patchouli for universal appeal |
| 16 | Dihydrojasmone | neat | 30 | 0.030 | **NEW** — VP 7.67 Pa, warm jasmine body, non-intrusive earthy-jasmine support |

**Heart subtotal: 1,430 µL — swirl after addition.**

---

### STEP 3 — TOP (add last, work quickly, cap immediately)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL | Why |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|-----|
| 17 | Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian | neat | 400 | 0.400 | **Bumped** — hedonic 0.80, bright opening |
| 18 | Grapefruit FCF | neat | 200 | 0.200 | Pithy dry freshness |
| 19 | Petitgrain EO | neat | 150 | 0.150 | Green neroli-citrus bridge |
| 20 | Black Pepper EO | neat | 80 | 0.080 | Spicy sparkle at trace |

**Top subtotal: 830 µL — cap immediately.**

---

### STEP 4 — ETHANOL

| # | Material | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----|----|
| 21 | Ethanol 96% | 24,735 | 24.735 |

Add in 3 portions (~8 mL each). Swirl 15 seconds between each.

---

**Concentrate: 5,265 µL (17.6%) · Total: 30,000 µL · 30 mL · 20 materials**

---

## HEADSPACE ANALYSIS — What your nose actually smells

| Material | Bottle µL | **Airborne** | % of air | Change from lean |
|----------|-----------|-------------|----------|-----------------|
| Iso E Super | 250 | **4,191 OAV** | **41.2%** | ↓ from 70.1% — no longer drowning |
| Lavender EO | 150 | **2,262 OAV** | **22.2%** | ↑ from 12.6% — herbal carrier |
| Dihydrojasmone | 30 | **1,526 OAV** | **15.0%** | NEW — warm jasmine body |
| Petitgrain EO | 150 | **646 OAV** | **6.3%** | ~same |
| Bergamot FCF | 400 | **574 OAV** | **5.6%** | ~same |
| Grapefruit FCF | 200 | **387 OAV** | **3.8%** | ~same |
| Cedramber | 250 | **318 OAV** | **3.1%** | ~same |
| Geraniol | 200 | **61 OAV** | **0.6%** | ~same |
| Vanillin | 30 a | **1 OAV** | trace | hedonic 0.90, sublimal warmth |
| Patchouli EO | 400 | **0.3 OAV** | 0% | Skin-substantive only (VP 0.001) |

**The airborne signature has shifted from "Iso E Super + citrus" to "Iso E Super + lavender + jasmine + citrus"** — a more honest representation of a patchouli chypre body.

---

## HEDONIC PROFILE

| Material | Hedonic | Role |
|----------|---------|------|
| Vanillin | **0.90** | Universal warmth — highest hedonic material |
| Bergamot FCF | **0.80** | Bright, fresh, universally liked |
| Hedione | **0.78** | Jasmonate radiance |
| Coumarin | **0.75** | Tonka hay warmth |
| Lavender EO | **0.75** | Herbal comfort |
| Grapefruit FCF | **0.75** | Citrus freshness |
| Geraniol | **0.70** | Rose-green friendliness |
| Dihydrojasmone | **0.70** | Warm jasmine — non-intrusive |
| Romandolide | **0.70** | Clean skin warmth |
| Galaxolide | **0.65** | Clean musk cushion |

**Weighted hedonic average: 0.651** — all materials score 0.50+. No negative-hedonic materials. Zero challenging notes.

---

## WHAT CHANGED FROM LEAN (18-mat)

| | Lean | **Balanced** |
|---|---|---|
| Iso E Super | 500 µL | **250 µL** — was 70% of airborne signal |
| Patchouli EO | 380 µL | **400 µL** — featured slightly more |
| Clearwood | 300 µL | **350 µL** |
| Vetiver EO | 250 µL | **280 µL** |
| Lavender EO | 100 µL | **150 µL** |
| Geraniol | 150 µL | **200 µL** |
| Bergamot FCF | 350 µL | **400 µL** |
| Coumarin | 120 µL | **150 µL** |
| **Vanillin** | — | **300 µL of 10%** (hedonic 0.90) |
| **Dihydrojasmone** | — | **30 µL** (VP 7.67, warm body) |
| Black Pepper EO | 90 µL | 80 µL |
| **EdP** | 16.6% | **17.6%** |

**Cut 200 µL Iso E Super, used that budget to add Vanillin, Dihydrojasmone, and bump the carriers.**

---

## WHAT IT SMELLS LIKE

**Opening:** Bright bergamot-grapefruit with a black pepper sparkle — fresh, modern, inviting.

**Heart:** Lavender-geranium herbal warmth with a transparent vanilla-cream halo and a warm jasmine body beneath. The Dihydrojasmone reads not as "jasmine flower" but as warm, full-bodied texture.

**Base:** Dark patchouli-earth over Clearwood-chocolate, anchored by Vetiver's dry roots and Evernyl's mossy powder. The Ambrox-Cedramber-Galaxolide base gives clean mineral projection.

**Drydown:** Soft vanilla-touched patchouli musk. Warm, clean, familiar. No smoke, no animalics, no challenge. This is the version you can wear to the office and ask "does this smell OK?" and get yes.

---

## EU ALLERGEN LABEL DECLARATIONS

| Material | Required |
|----------|---------|
| Geraniol | Yes |
| Benzyl Salicylate | Yes |
| Coumarin | Yes |
| Vanillin | Not restricted |
| Lavender EO | Not restricted |

---

*Balanced version. 20 materials, 17.6% EdP. Headspace-optimized for equal airborne distribution. Hedonic-weighted for universal appeal. All materials verified against inventory.txt.*

Near-field: Galaxolide, Clearwood, Benzyl Salicylate, Romandolide, Vanillin

mixing_protocol.title: Green Patchouli Cologne Balanced — Citrus Patchouli Chypre

instructions: 1. Dissolve Coumarin in warm ethanol or DPG (40-50°C) until fully clear before adding to formula.
2. Dissolve Vanillin in warm ethanol or DPG (40-50°C) until fully clear before adding to formula.

Step 3. Add Ambrox Super (5.7%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.

Step 4. Add Galaxolide (13.3%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.

Step 5. Add Iso E Super (4.75%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.

Step 6. Add Cedramber (4.75%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.

Step 7. Add Benzyl Salicylate (5.7%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.

Step 8. Add Romandolide (4.75%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
→ Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

Step 9. Add Patchouli EO (7.6%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 10. Add Vetiver EO (5.32%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 11. Add Black Pepper EO (1.52%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 12. Add Clearwood (6.65%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 13. Add Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian (7.6%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 14. Add Petitgrain EO (2.85%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 15. Add Hedione (9.5%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 16. Add Evernyl (0.47%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 17. Add Dihydrojasmone (0.57%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
→ Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

Step 18. Add Grapefruit FCF (3.8%)
